We cannot afford to give an inch in this war. Day and night, I create new armor, and I patch whatever can be salvaged from the old. I have no time for other tasks. Would you take care of something for me?

The ravasaur here in Un'Goro seem to be related to the raptors of the barrens--highly intelligent, volatile, and with a sense or code of conduct. The greatest of these that I have encountered is  Lar'korwi. He is one of the most dangerous beasts I've ever seen. In taurahe, Lar'korwi means "sharp claw," but that does not do him justice.$B$BDo not underestimate Lar'korwi if you ever plan on hunting him, but I will help you in any way I can if you do.
